Muslim Youth Carries Ganesha Idol, Symbolizing Inter-Faith Harmony

In Mandi Ahmedgarh, a Muslim youth carried the idol of Lord Ganesha to his home, marking the beginning of the 11-day Ganesh Chaturthi festival. This act has been highlighted as a symbol of inter-faith harmony. The festival, which involves welcoming Lord Ganesha, is being celebrated across Mumbai and other parts of India.
